caption_used: 图表展示了不同超参数设置对BLEU分数的影响，包含两个子图。左图中横轴为知识蒸馏权重α，范围从0.1到0.9；右图中横轴为掩码概率p，范围从0.05到0.45。两图纵轴均为BLEU得分，范围从28.0到28.6。左图显示α=0.5时BLEU达到峰值约28.53，α=0.1时最低约27.95。右图中p=0.15时BLEU达到峰值约28.53。值得注意的是，参数p对BLEU分数的影响幅度明显大于α，p在0.25处出现显著下降至约28.1后又回升，表明模型对掩码概率的选择更为敏感；相较之下α的影响曲线则较为平缓对称。
raw_response:
This figure consists of two side-by-side line charts that illustrate the effect of different hyperparameter settings on BLEU scores. Both charts share the same y-axis label, BLEU, with a range from approximately 28.0 to 28.6, using linear scaling with tick intervals of 0.1.

The left chart has its x-axis labeled as α, with values at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9, representing knowledge distillation weight. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. Starting at α = 0.1, the BLEU score is approximately 27.95. The line rises to about 28.33 at α = 0.3, then reaches a peak of approximately 28.53 at α = 0.5. From there, the line decreases to about 28.40 at α = 0.7, and further drops to approximately 28.12 at α = 0.9.

The right chart has its x-axis labeled as p, with values at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45, representing mask probability. A single blue line with circular markers connects the data points. At p = 0.05, the BLEU score is approximately 28.31. The line rises to a peak of approximately 28.53 at p = 0.15, then drops to about 28.42 at p = 0.25. The score increases slightly to approximately 28.47 at p = 0.35, and then decreases again to about 28.43 at p = 0.45.
